ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2022; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2020; VFSC Act No. 10 of 2017; Financial Dealers Act [Cap. 62] (only if licensing is later triggered); Financial Institutions Act [Cap. 173].

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of valid passport of each director, shareholder, and beneficial owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or commissioning officer in country of origin; certified by a licensed Vanuatu Registered Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention; certification must be legalized by a Vanuatu High Commission/Consulate or the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Trade and Tourism)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police clearance / criminal record certificate for each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police or competent criminal records authority of each country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization by the nearest Vanuatu diplomatic mission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming financial standing and business reputation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank of the existing or intended corporate bank account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized by a notary in the bank's jurisdiction; Consular Legalization may be required if the bank reference will be admitted to Vanuatu public files

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: For corporate shareholders: certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles of association, register of directors, and UBO declaration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry of the country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the issuing jurisdiction is a member of the Hague Apostille Convention; otherwise Consular Legalization by Vanuatu diplomatic mission

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs, and authorized signatories against OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, and Vanuatu domestic sanctions list. Enhanced due diligence is required for politically exposed persons (PEPs) per FATF standards and the Vanuatu Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2020. Continuous adverse media monitoring and transaction monitoring apply.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Corporate Registry – Online Name Reservation Service (submitted through licensed Registered Agents)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All company names must use Latin script. Non-English or non-French names require an English transliteration. Bislama names are accepted if clear and capable of being written in Latin characters. The suffix 'Limited' or 'Ltd' is mandatory. The Registrar has discretion to refuse names that may mislead or offend public order.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be extended for one further 30-day period upon application to the VFSC with payment of the extension fee before the initial period expires. If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant or its Registered Agent may file a formal written appeal with the VFSC within 14 days of rejection, stating the reasons why the name should be accepted. If the Registrar affirms the rejection, a further appeal may be made to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the International Companies Act. A fresh name reservation application may also be filed immediately with a revised distinctive element.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted with conditions: the statutory registered office must be the physical office of the licensed Vanuatu Registered Agent in Port Vila; no local operational office is required for a social casino/publishing company, but the company must maintain records, books, and have a resident agent. Virtual administrative office arrangements are acceptable for this industry provided substance requirements such as a registered agent and suitable records are met.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (10-15% annual probability) for a non-licensed software publishing company; probability rises to over 40% if the company later applies for any financial services license or registers as a financial dealer.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act, Cap 222 (Sections 5, 6, 10, 11, 15 and 18); Companies (Amendment) Act 2013
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Companies Registry Division, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form 1) and Registered Agent Consent (Form 2) filed under the International Companies Act
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; authorized share capital is stated in the Articles. A minimum of two shareholders and one director are required; no escrow account requirement applies for a tax-exempt International Company.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The First Board Resolution of the sole director/shareholder approves: (1) adoption of the final Articles of Incorporation as filed with VFSC; (2) subscription of one (1) ordinary share at USD 1.00 par value in accordance with the share register; (3) adoption of the registered office and registered agent address situated at Port Vila, Vanuatu, in compliance with the International Companies Act; (4) appointment of the first directors, one corporate Secretary, and a Compliance Officer; and (5) opening of a corporate bank account with digital-asset-compatible banking partner for operational treasury. The resolution is effective upon passage and supersedes all prior draft resolutions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry (Port Vila, Vanuatu) – online name search portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request via the VFSC online portal or in-person Form 5 (Name Reservation), indicating the proposed corporate name containing a permissible suffix ('Limited' or 'Ltd'). Payment of the statutory name reservation fee (USD 50) via bank transfer or card. Wait for VFSC name availability confirmation before proceeding to incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Name search receipt issued by VFSC online system
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused on grounds of undesirable resemblance or prohibited expression, file a written appeal to the VFSC Registrar or submit an amended name choice for re-screening within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Incorporation Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a VFSC-licensed registered agent (mandatory). Execute Articles of Incorporation, Notice of Registered Office, and Consent of Registered Agent. Provide certified passport copies, utility bill for residential address, bank reference letter, and statutory declaration of the director (Form 4). All signatures must be notarized by a Vanuatu notary or apostilled consular officer; then submit original wet-ink documents to the agent.
required_dossiers: Proof of residential address (utility bill, bank statement)
Bank reference letter for each shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a query letter (deficiency notice), the registered agent files the requested supplementary documentation within 10 business days; non-compliant documents may be rejected and re-submitted with a new filing date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Companies Registry Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete incorporation dossier (executed Articles plus all forms) through the registered agent to VFSC. Pay the official government filing fee of USD 350 (including Certificate of Incorporation) via the designated VFSC bank account or an approved VFSC portal. Upon verification, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation with a unique Company Number (four-digit sequence). Obtain a certified extract of the Certificate.
required_dossiers: Full incorporation pack (Form 1, Form 2, Form 3, Form 4)
Receipt of government filing fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC imposes additional conditions or refuses registration, request a written statement of reasons; file an appeal to the VFSC Registrar within 14 days, or correct the deficiency and resubmit within 20 business days to avoid double filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Share Certificates and Opening of Corporate Bank/VASP Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent / Approved Vanuatu Corporate Bank (e.g., National Bank of Vanuatu or licensed offshore banking partner)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After VFSC issuance, the registered agent prepares share certificates to be signed and issued by the directors. Convene the First Board Resolution (as per pro-forma). Open a corporate bank account with a licensed Vanuatu or regional bank, submitting the Certificate of Incorporation, registered agent certificate (Form 9), director/shareholder KYC pack, and the Board Resolution authorizing the corporate signatories and accounts. For digital-asset rails (Apple IAP / Google Play Billing), additionally submit a corporate merchant application to a payment processor with an operating agreement (e.g., Stripe, Payku, or similar) referencing the company's tax exemption certificate.
required_dossiers: Certified KYC pack (passport, proof of address, apostille)
Corporate account application forms and merchant agreement
Certificate of Tax Exemption (issued by Ministry of Finance upon incorporation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or payment processor queries beneficial ownership, provide an updated corporate register extract and supplemental source-of-funds affidavit; submit to the bank’s Compliance Committee; an escalation to the VFSC-registered agent is available as a supporting reference.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industry Licensing: not applicable for digital publishing; governed solely by VFSC and Vanuatu Office of the Government Chief Information Officer (OGCIO) for online service data handling. For any incidental physical storage/office lease: Ministry of Internal Affairs for local business license.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: VFSC International Company active status; local operating permit not required for pure digital social-casino publishing; however, a Telecommunications and ICT Activity License (Class 2 – Non-Facility Based) may be required for hosting online services to Vanuatu users – recommended as best practice.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (No EIA required) – classified as a zero-emission software-as-a-service operation with no physical plant; registration only is mandatory under the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations 2020 Schedules 2 and 3 for any office fit-out exceeding 1,000 sqm, which is not anticipated.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater discharge, VOC emissions, or solid waste generated by the digital publishing activity. For any ancillary office premises: compliance with National Building Code (structural load) and Vanuatu Waste Management Regulations is limited to office e-waste recycling and general municipal waste segregation; cloud hosting provider must maintain ISO 14001 data center environmental certification and renewable-energy power usage effectiveness (PUE) below 1.5.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate required for any leased office space (issued by the Vanuatu National Disaster Management Office / municipal fire brigade) – includes emergency exit signage, extinguisher inspection, and evacuation plan. Structural load clearance is waived for a remote-first workforce with no printing facility; if an office is leased, a structural load inspection certificate for an occupancy load not exceeding 200 persons must be filed with the building authority. Workplace clearance includes electrical installation certificate (EIC) and an occupational safety walkthrough report by the Ministry of Labour – applicable only if physical office is taken.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA) — https://www.vrca.gov.vu — responsible solely for customs and excise administration; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — https://www.vfsc.vu — statutory regulator for International Company incorporation, annual returns, and prescribed fees. No national income-tax administration exists because Vanuatu levies no income, corporate, capital-gains, or inheritance tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: No TIN or VAT identification number exists in Vanuatu law. A foreign-owned entity registers as an International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] through a VFSC-licensed Corporate Service Provider by lodging the memorandum and articles of association, registered-agent consent, registered-office address, and particulars of directors and shareholders. The VFSC then issues the Certificate of Incorporation and a unique Company Number, which is the sole statutory identifier. Post-incorporation obligations are: (a) maintain a registered agent and registered office in Vanuatu; (b) file an annual return on each anniversary date with the VFSC; and (c) pay the prescribed annual government fee. No tax registration, tax clearance, or fiscal identification is required for the IC to invoice foreign counterparties.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None applicable. Vanuatu has no check-the-box, pass-through election, CFC attribution, or hybrid-mismatch rules. Tax exemption is mandatory and automatic under section 89 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222], which exempts the IC from all present and future Vanuatu taxes, duties, and stamp duties on its income, shares, securities, and operations. The IC may not elect to be taxable. A shareholder's home jurisdiction may independently classify the IC as a controlled foreign corporation or look-through entity, and may apply its own hybrid-mismatch or anti-deferral rules under foreign domestic law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None — Vanuatu imposes no VAT, GST, or general sales and use tax. The Value Added Tax Act No. 26 of 1998 (12.5% standard rate) was repealed effective 1 July 2018. Indirect levies are limited to customs duties on physical imports and a narrowly scoped fiscal stamp duty on specified domestic instruments; neither applies to exported digital software services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no indirect-tax registration threshold exists; there is no VAT/GST statute, no turnover threshold, and no de minimis supply rule for digital services. The IC's sale of simulated social casino software through Apple IAP and Google Play Billing is entirely outside Vanuatu's indirect-tax perimeter.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no electronic-invoicing clearance system, no real-time fiscal API, and no digital stamping mandate. The VRCA operates ASYCUDA World solely for customs declarations. The IC may issue ordinary commercial invoices to Apple Inc. and Google LLC without any Vanuatu fiscal format, QR coding, or clearance step.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — with no VAT regime, there is no 0% export rate to claim and no VAT refund to substantiate. Exportation of software-publishing services by the IC is simply outside Vanuatu revenue jurisdiction. The International Companies Act prohibits ICs from trading with Vanuatu residents, which further confirms the wholly offshore export nexus. Should the IC ever ship physical promotional merchandise, no Vanuatu export duty applies to the majority of goods and no refund mechanism is triggered because no indirect tax is collected. The 0-day value of the repatriation deadline reflects the complete absence of exchange-control or mandatory-repatriation legislation in Vanuatu; export proceeds may remain offshore indefinitely.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: No statutory Vanuatu customs or fiscal documentation is required for digital exports of simulated social casino games; the IC is not subject to export declarations for intangible services.

VFSC annual return (mandatory under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]); accounting records of the IC must be maintained at the registered office of the registered agent and produced to the VFSC upon lawful demand.
Commercial invoices issued to Apple Inc. and Google LLC; developer-programme billing statements serve as the primary revenue substantiation for banking and AML purposes.

If physical merchandise is exported in future: Customs Export Declaration and Bill of Lading or Airway Bill would become relevant, but no fiscal clearance or export-duty payment arises for the IC's software publishing activity.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu law provides no VAT or income-tax clawback mechanism, so export zero-rating fraud is legally impossible. Enforcement exposure is limited to: (i) VFSC administrative penalties and late fees for failure to file the annual return; (ii) striking-off of the IC and forfeiture of its property to the Government if annual fees remain unpaid; (iii) criminal liability for false statements or forgery in documents lodged with the VFSC, punishable by fine or imprisonment under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; and (iv) civil liability to third parties for misrepresentation. Foreign tax claims against the IC would be adjudicated under the relevant foreign taxing statute, not under Vanuatu law.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV); the RBV administers the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 100], issues the national currency (Vatu, VUV), manages foreign exchange reserves, and supervises licensed banks. The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) regulates the International Company registry and non-bank financial services.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu has accepted IMF Article VIII obligations and maintains a fully liberalized exchange system for both current and capital account transactions. Foreign exchange is freely obtainable from authorized dealers (commercial banks) for bona fide trade, services, investments, and profit remittances. There are no prior RBV approval requirements for current international transfers, dividend distributions, or capital repatriations by an International Company, provided the remitting bank has completed standard source-of-funds and AML/CTF checks. The VUV is convertible to all major currencies (USD, AUD, EUR, GBP, NZD) at market-determined rates, though onshore liquidity for minor currencies may be limited.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu does not impose any statutory export proceeds surrender or mandatory conversion requirement. An International Company (IC) may retain export or service revenue in any freely convertible currency in offshore or onshore accounts without time limits or conversion obligations. The only applicable duties are record-keeping obligations under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2002 and the AML/CTF Regulations, requiring transaction documentation and customer due diligence records to be maintained for at least six years.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Wise, Payoneer, Mercury, Airwallex) generally rate as Low for a Vanuatu International Company engaged in social casino gaming. Most established EMIs decline Vanuatu-registered corporate accounts due to increased country risk, beneficial ownership opacity, and the gaming-adjacent business model. Some EMI products may be available for payment collection (e.g., Stripe, PayPal) but are subject to contractual gambling restrictions and risk-based underwriting. Legal constraints include the need for the EMI to hold a valid e-money license in its home jurisdiction, cross-border KYC/AML equivalency, and compliance with VFSC anti-money-laundering expectations if the IC is a higher-risk customer. For treasury resilience, the IC should rely primarily on tier-1 onshore commercial banks and use EMIs only as secondary settlement channels, not as primary repositories of liquidity.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of at least one director or the company's registered agent is generally mandated for onshore Vanuatu corporate account opening. Most tier-1 banks require an in-person interview at their Port Vila branch with the beneficial owner or a senior authorized officer. Remote onboarding is permitted only on an exceptional, risk-tested basis, typically involving video conference for the initial interview, notarized and apostilled corporate documents, banker's references, and a physical local introducer (registered agent or law firm). For the social casino typology, banks will effectively impose a mandatory physical meeting or a pre-approved intermediary introduction due to enhanced due diligence expectations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk business typology: publishing simulated social casino / virtual slots games may be perceived as a gateway to unlicensed gambling or money laundering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide (1) a legal opinion from a recognized gaming attorney confirming the activity is restricted to social casino games with no real-money wagering, no cash payouts, and no prize redemption; (2) a screenshot/architecture of the in-app purchase model denying real-money withdrawal; (3) Apple App Store and Google Play developer terms confirming the consent to their paid-app monetization standards; (4) a third-party AML/CFT risk assessment for the gaming platform; (5) a corporate policy prohibiting any form of sweepstakes with monetary value.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Vanuatu tax-exempt status and low substance profile of the International Company, raising concerns about tax evasion or absence of genuine economic activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide (1) a physical office lease agreement in Vanuatu or documentation of local professional administration; (2) a detailed substance report demonstrating operational direction and management in-country; (3) board resolutions, minutes, and employment contracts of local officers; (4) an up-to-date VFSC International Company certificate of good standing; (5) proactive tax opinions from the beneficial owner's residence jurisdiction confirming no tax evasion motive; (6) annual financial statements filed with VFSC (if applicable) or reviewed by a licensed accountant.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity for a non-resident-owned international company, especially where the ultimate owner is located in a high-risk or high-tax jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a complete corporate structure chart from the natural-person beneficial owner to the VU_IC entity; certified copies of passports and proof of residential address; an executed source-of-wealth statement; bank reference letters from the homeland bank; a declaration of trusts or nominee arrangements; and certified translations of all corporate documentation. Engage the registered agent as the designated contact for compliance inquiries.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected high-velocity transaction flows from Apple IAP and Google Play Billing, which banks may flag as unusual turnover or inconsistent with a typical treasury profile.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide (1) signed distribution agreements with Apple/Google including revenue share percentages and payout terms; (2) historical payout statements from Apple and Google for the previous 6–12 months to establish a pattern; (3) a cash-flow model reconciling expected inflows to development, marketing, and licensing expenses; (4) operational contracts with app developers, cloud service providers, and payment processors; (5) a written AML/CFT transaction monitoring policy and designated compliance officer.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections into a Vanuatu International Company should be routed via SWIFT MT103 transfer from the shareholder's bank to the company's USD (or VUV) account at a tier-1 Vanuatu commercial bank. The payment narrative must clearly state the purpose as 'Equity capital contribution to VU_IC' or 'Shareholder loan facility to VU_IC'. No prior RBV approval is required for inbound foreign investment; however, the receiving bank will apply its domestic transaction reporting threshold (typically USD 10,000 equivalent) and may request supporting source-of-funds documents such as the share subscription agreement, a board resolution authorizing capital increase, and a certificate of deposit for the beneficiary account. For amounts above USD 1,000,000, banks may require enhanced due diligence including a written explanation of the economic substance and a signed declaration from the director.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Approved clearing rails for trade settlements and operational disbursements include: (1) SWIFT MT103 for standard vendor payments, licensing fees, and intercompany transfers; (2) SWIFT MT202 COV for interbank buy-funds transfers when moving liquidity between banks; (3) Commercial Letters of Credit (documentary L/C) for physical goods-based software distribution or hardware purchases, using ICC UCP 600 rules; (4) Documentary Collections (URC 522) for low-to-moderate value transactions with trusted counterparties. For digital-content revenues from Apple and Google, funds are settled automatically via ACH/SEPA/direct deposit into the company's nominated bank account; no separate clearing rail is needed. The IC should always maintain a reconciliation trail linking outbound SWIFT messages to signed contracts, invoices, and per-transaction FX risk records.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards up to 12 months with an authorized commercial bank in VUV/USD, VUV/AUD, VUV/EUR, and VUV/NZD for hedging known contractual exposures
FX swaps between VUV and major traded currencies for short-term liquidity management
Cross-currency swaps (fixed-for-floating) on a commercial hedge basis, with the approval of the counterparty risk committee

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not prohibited by Vanuatu regulation but are not commonly offered onshore; they may be executed through offshore counterparties only if the underlying commercial exposure is documented and the transaction is not speculative

OTC FX options (vanilla puts/calls) may be permissible on a case-by-case basis from a licensed foreign exchange dealer, subject to internal bank approval and documentary evidence of a real underlying exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (International Companies Act Cap 222, s. 103) for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after each anniversary of incorporation (recurring annual anniversary cycle)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge plus statutory penalty for continuing default (up to VUV 200,000); after written notice, the Registrar may strike the company off the international companies register under s. 106, with consequential vesting of company assets in the Republic.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Register annual confirmation and update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC via licensed registered agent; register is maintained in Vanuatu and accessible to competent authorities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation filed concurrently with the Annual Return; any change in beneficial ownership reported to the registered agent within 14 days of completion
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Continuing offence under the beneficial ownership regime; fines up to VUV 200,000 and daily default penalties for non-disclosure; deliberate omission triggers regulatory inspection and potential strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office continuation confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC (maintained by the licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, effective as of the incorporation anniversary; immediate notification to the Registrar on any agent resignation, change of office, or termination of agency
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Operating without a licensed registered agent or registered office is a statutory contravention; the Registrar may initiate default strike-off proceedings against an unrepresented company after formal notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Tax-exempt status declaration confirming no prohibited business with Vanuatu residents
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC as part of the Annual Return; underlying records available to the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually with the Annual Return (anniversary date plus 30 calendar days)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Misdeclaration or carrying on business with Vanuatu residents voids tax exemptions, exposes the company to local taxation and penalties of up to VUV 200,000, and may result in revocation of international company status.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for a standard non-licensed International Company; mandatory independent audit applies only to VFSC-licensed regulated entities (securities dealing, banking, insurance, trust). A social casino / virtual slots publisher operating as an ordinary IC has no revenue- or asset-based audit trigger, and the Apple IAP / Google Play Billing payments rails do not constitute regulated financial services in Vanuatu.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No Vanuatu statutory GAAP or IFRS filing obligation; directors must retain accounting records that sufficiently explain transactions and fairly disclose financial position under s. 69 of the International Companies Act Cap 222; voluntary audits may adopt IFRS, US GAAP, or internationally accepted local GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed registered agent must verify and record each beneficial owner as of the anniversary date; the Annual Return confirms the current beneficial ownership schedule, and any share transfer, allotment, or change in ownership must be lodged with the agent within 14 days of completion, with the agent updating the VFSC register accordingly.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $650 - $1,500 per annum (licensed Vanuatu registered agent plus registered office service)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required for unlicensed IC; voluntary certified audit typically USD 1,500 - 5,000 depending on payment-rail transaction volumes and reconciliation complexity.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% on foreign-source profits of an International Company (IC); a 10% Corporate Income Tax rate applies exclusively to profits derived from onshore/Vanuatu-source business activity under the Corporate Income Tax Act 2024 (effective 1 January 2025) and does not affect exempt ICs that refrain from domestic business.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero effective taxation on qualifying offshore business: statutory exemption from Vanuatu income tax, capital gains tax, dividend withholding tax, interest withholding tax, royalty withholding tax, and estate/gift duties. Value Added Tax (12.5%) applies only to taxable supplies of goods or services consumed in Vanuatu. The recurrent cost is limited to the VFSC annual renewal fee and the licensed registered agent fee. Foreign-source revenue from licensed gaming or software platforms is domestically tax-free.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Vanuatu corporate income tax return applies to an exempt IC. The mandatory annual compliance filing is the International Company Annual Return submitted to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through the VFSC Online Registry portal (OGR).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Return and annual renewal fee must be filed within 30 days after the anniversary of the date of incorporation; failing the anniversary-month window triggers late-filing surcharges and arrears on the annual fee.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name, International Company registration number, incorporation date, and place of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident principals must quote the VFSC registration certificate number and must not present a trading name implying onshore Vanuatu service provision.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Registered Agent and Registered Office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, licence number, and contact details of the VFSC-licensed registered agent together with the physical registered office address in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident owner cannot file directly; the licensed local agent must attest and file, while the owner must supply updated beneficial-ownership information to the agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, nationalities, residential addresses, and passport or national identification numbers of each director, secretary, and officer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be non-resident natural persons, but at least one natural person director is required; any change must be communicated to the licensed agent within 21 days.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital, classes, par value, shareholder register, and percentage of beneficial ownership.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: One hundred percent non-resident shareholding is permitted; bearer shares are prohibited, and ultimate beneficial owners must be disclosed to the registered agent although they are not publicly registered.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 - Business Activity and Compliance Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of current business purpose, confirmation that no domestic business is conducted with Vanuatu residents, and confirmation of relevant-activity status under the Economic Substance Regulations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The declaration must state that the IC conducts no domestic commerce, owns no restricted Vanuatu assets, and does not hold itself out as a Vanuatu-resident casino or payment operator.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the Annual Return triggers a VFSC late fee of up to VT 10,000 plus compounded monthly arrears on the annual renewal fee; persistent default leads to administrative removal or strike-off from the register, dissolution without succession, and personal liability of directors for penalties incurred during the default period.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% domestic withholding tax on dividends paid by a Vanuatu International Company to non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has a very limited double taxation agreement network. Where an applicable DTA exists, treaty relief is invoked by obtaining a Tax Residency Certificate through the VFSC-licensed agent, submitting the certificate together with proof of beneficial ownership to the source-country payer and tax authority within the treaty claim period, and filing a DTA relief application with the Vanuatu competent authority. Because the IC is exempt from domestic withholding tax, dividend, royalty, and interest repatriation proceeds without Vanuatu tax clearance; the principal practical risk is source-country app-store or payment-channel withholding, which must be recovered through foreign tax credit or treaty refund procedures.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax on outbound royalties and debt interest: 0%. Treaty-restricted rates, where an applicable DTA overrides, normally range from 0% to 5% for royalties and 0% to 10% for interest, conditional on beneficial ownership. For payment rails such as Apple IAP and Google Play Billing, the marketplace payment processor may levy source-state withholding, so the IC must document the economic ownership of the licensed IP to support treaty or credit claims.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Vanuatu does not yet prescribe a statutory Local File or Master File threshold in Vatu; the prudent compliance threshold is VT 10,000,000 (approximately USD 82,000) of annual cross-border controlled transactions, above which contemporaneous master file, local file, and intercompany agreements aligned with OECD transfer pricing guidance should be maintained.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Requirements apply through the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019. The relevant activities are banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, distribution and service-centre business, and holding-company business. A pure publisher of simulated social casino and virtual slots content under ISIC 5820, monetised solely through Apple IAP and Google Play Billing, is not itself a scheduled relevant activity. However, any arrangement with a Vanuatu distribution or service-centre function, in-country operating staff, or a Vanuatu IP holding and licensing entity will invoke the ESR substance test: local board management, adequate physical premises, proportionate staff, and operating expenditure commensurate with the relevant income. Vanuatu remains subject to EU monitoring for tax transparency, and failure of ESR reporting can lead to denial of the tax-exempt status.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a nominee-managed IC with no genuine board meetings in Vanuatu, no local decision-making, no physical presence, and claiming tax-exempt status while the simulated casino application, intellectual property, management, and revenue decisions are controlled entirely offshore, including deliberately misdeclaring ESR relevant-activity status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019: fines per offence of up to VT 10,000,000 and daily default penalties of up to VT 1,000,000 for continuing contravention; the VFSC may strike off the company, impose reporting restrictions, and refer the matter for prosecution under the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2016.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, shadow directors, and beneficial owners may be held jointly and severally liable for recoverable penalties and taxes, subject to civil recovery orders, asset freezes, travel bans, disqualification orders, and imprisonment for up to 12 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Marketing or supplying the simulated casino product or in-app virtual currency to persons in Vanuatu; owning Vanuatu immovable property or controlled-interest domestic assets; or carrying on banking, securities, or real-money gambling activity without the required VFSC or Reserve Bank of Vanuatu licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Loss of the IC zero-tax exemption with retrospective assessment of profits; Value Added Tax Act assessments at 12.5% with penalty interest of up to 200% of the under-declared amount; and criminal prosecution for tax evasion with fines up to VT 15,000,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may pierce the corporate veil: directors, officers, and the offshore principal face personal liability for assessed amounts, restitution of concealed profits, forfeiture of foreign assets, travel bans, and imprisonment for up to 7 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Deficiency and Unlicensed Payment Intermediation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Channeling Apple IAP and Google Play Billing settlement flows through the IC while failing to maintain adequate AML/CFT controls, beneficial-ownership records, transaction monitoring, and sanctions screening; or providing payment wallet, e-money, or remittance services to third parties without the statutory licence, thereby exposing the social casino structure to money-laundering exploitation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AML/CFT Act enforcement: corporate penalties up to VT 20,000,000 for each violation, forfeiture and confiscation of unlawful proceeds, revocation of the IC registration, and prohibition from holding a VFSC licence; serious breaches are referred to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Executives and ultimate beneficial owners face personal criminal fines up to VT 5,000,000, disqualification, travel bans, confiscation of personal property, and imprisonment for up to 10 years for money laundering or knowingly operating without the required authorisation.
